name: video-company
description: AI Visual Conversation Assistant — camera + microphone + vision AI

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules shared/node_modules client/dist server/dist shared/dist
